change: For each actual Brownian FIRE timestamp, decay content to event time and apply one event operator, then decay to observation and write, instead of per-observation total-count aggregation.
training: Use existing P2 aggregate-count-trained frozen seed0 weights (400 updates, train_n=test_n=256, hidden 32); regenerate deterministic via train_pilot and require weight digest match. NO retraining for the new timed operator.
paired_data: Identical examples, timestamps, FIRE stream seed/identity and frozen model for both arms. Copy and MQAR4 tasks, sequence lengths 16 ID and 32 OOD; data seeds 200 and 300. 256 actors per task/length; queries: 256 Copy or 1024 MQAR4 per slice.
endpoints: Per-actor paired accuracy delta (timed minus aggregate)
Process CPU and wall seconds, both include FIRE sampling/recurrent content/head but exclude model loading/training
primary_functional_gates: All sampled FIRE timestamps identical across arms
Exact split/whole and new-process model-bound snapshot equality
Invalid event/timestamps/checkpoints fail with no in-memory state change
scientific_gate: P2 and P0-P5 remain OPEN. This is a frozen-weight model-migration stress test, not matched-budget retraining or evidence of improved learning quality.
explicit_restrictions: No training advantage claim from frozen aggregate-trained weights
CPU float32 content only; no CUDA/Rust/physical Joules
No host durable journal or authenticated checkpoint
No hidden materialization of historical failures
